title: Maria's Day
text:
Maria wakes up at six o'clock every morning. She takes a shower and eats breakfast with her family. She drinks a cup of coffee and eats bread with butter. Then she walks to the bus stop.

Maria works in a small shop in the city. She starts work at nine o'clock. In the evening, she goes home at six. She likes to read a book before she goes to sleep.

questions.text: What time does Maria wake up?
Why does Maria probably get up early?
options: She has to catch a bus to work

questions.text: What kind of person is Maria probably?
options: A person who is always tired and unhappy
A person who never eats breakfast
A person with a regular daily routine
A person who works at night

vocabulary.definition: water that falls on your body to wash it
the first meal of the day
a place where you buy things
to rest with your eyes closed at night

paragraph_translations: Maria acorda às seis horas todas as manhãs. Ela toma banho e come o café da manhã com a família. Ela bebe uma xícara de café e come pão com manteiga. Depois, ela caminha até o ponto de ônibus.
Maria trabalha em uma pequena loja na cidade. Ela começa o trabalho às nove horas. À noite, ela volta para casa às seis. Ela gosta de ler um livro antes de dormir.
